tasks.spec:
You are a repo feature worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo (/mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory) at HEAD — edit files here directly.

OWNERSHIP BOUNDARY: you own exactly five paths: departments/podcast/runtime/funnel_floor_sensor.py (new), departments/podcast/runtime/compare_charter.py, departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh, departments/podcast/tests/test_funnel_floor_sensor.py (new), departments/podcast/tests/test_compare_charter.py. Nothing else. NEVER touch departments/podcast/charter.yaml (governance, human-only — read it, never write it). Never touch .git, never commit, never run git add; leave changes uncommitted.

CONTEXT: the owner's finding (2026-08-05): 'all my loops... they don't drive.' The charter now carries six funnel-floor objectives (active_warm_threads>=10, live_replies>=4, prep_done_awaiting_recording>=3, recordings_booked_future>=2, stale_touches=0, expired_holds_unactioned=0) and a thresholds.funnel_drive quota block (steady 4 new outreaches/week, rebuild 8/week while hopper_depth<6, touch cadence <=7 days, expired holds actioned same day). Read the charter comments — they carry the owner's reasoning. Nothing measures these yet. Your job: the daily DRIVE CHECK sensor so a quiet day means the funnel moved, and a miss becomes a plain-language escalation via the existing compare->escalate chain.

BUILD 1 — departments/podcast/runtime/funnel_floor_sensor.py, a deterministic sensor mirroring the conventions of departments/podcast/runtime/hopper_sensor.py (same CLI shape: --state-dir, --sources, --pipeline-repo, --shadow/--no-shadow; same observation-append and objectives_observed update mechanics — read hopper_sensor.py first and reuse its helpers' patterns; import shared helpers if hopper exposes them, else mirror). Data source: <pipeline-repo>/episodes/FUNNEL-LEDGER.json (schema funnel-ledger/v1: people[] with id, name, stage, last_touch{at,direction,source}, hold{next_action_on,...}, evidence[], updated_at). Compute per floor, with 'active' = stage not in {published, closed, rejected} and not None:
  - active_warm_threads: active people whose last_touch.at is within 7 days of now
  - live_replies: active people whose last_touch.direction == 'inbound' with last_touch.at within 14 days, plus any stage in {responded, in_conversation} if present
  - prep_done_awaiting_recording: people at stage prep_call_done (or prep-done variants) without a recording-booked stage
  - recordings_booked_future: episodes under <pipeline-repo>/episodes/*/episode.json at stage recording-booked whose recording/publish date field is today or later; if no usable date evidence exists, this floor is UNKNOWN, never guessed
  - stale_touches: active people with last_touch.at absent or older than 7 days
  - expired_holds_unactioned: people whose hold.next_action_on is strictly before today and whose last_touch.at is absent or earlier than that expiry
  - drive quota: outbound touches this ISO week = active-or-any people with last_touch.direction=='outbound' and last_touch.at >= Monday 00:00 UTC of the current week; quota = rebuild (8) when the current objectives_observed hopper_depth < 6 else steady (4), read from the charter's thresholds.funnel_drive — never hardcode the numbers.
Emit ONE observation per floor plus one for the quota (sensor='funnel', subject=<floor name>, status ok|alarm|unknown, evidence citing the ledger path, metrics with the computed count and the floor), and write the six floor values into objectives_observed the same way hopper_sensor writes its objectives. Ledger missing/unreadable => every floor UNKNOWN with the reason in detail. The sensor process always exits 0 (statuses carry the signal; a crash would kill the chain).

BUILD 2 — departments/podcast/runtime/compare_charter.py: add transitions ('funnel','alarm') -> ('funnel_behind','high') and ('funnel','unknown') -> ('funnel_blind','med'), a QUESTIONS entry for 'funnel', and MEANINGS entries for both classes written for a non-technical owner (the existing test bans jargon words in what_it_means — follow the existing MEANINGS style exactly). Example tone for funnel_behind: what_it_means='The guest pipeline fell behind its daily numbers, so future episodes are at risk of running dry.', what_it_needs='Approve the catch-up actions the loops propose, or tell them to pause the pace; the daily work order has the exact items.'

BUILD 3 — departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh: invoke the new sensor in the stage-1 sensing chain immediately after the hopper sensor, using the exact same launch pattern and tolerance the hopper invocation uses (read the script; mirror it precisely, including PYTHONPATH/launcher conventions). Do not reorder or alter any other chain step.

TESTS: departments/podcast/tests/test_funnel_floor_sensor.py with tmp_path ledger fixtures covering: each floor computed correctly at, above, and below its line (ok vs alarm); unknown on missing ledger and on undatable recordings; quota rebuild-vs-steady switching on hopper_depth; expired-hold detection honoring a post-expiry touch as actioned. Extend departments/podcast/tests/test_compare_charter.py so the completeness/meanings tests cover the two new classes (they may pass automatically via parametrization — verify, and add a funnel_behind classification regression test either way).

HOW TO RUN (from the worktree root — all must pass): PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest departments/podcast/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 loopfactory.py check && bash -n departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh

HARD RULES: stdlib only; deterministic (no network, no model calls, no MCP, no skills); never weaken deny-by-default (unknown is unknown, never assumed ok); no reformatting of untouched code; smallest coherent diff; leave changes uncommitted — the coordinator lands, re-shadows, and re-pins the release.
